fullContentHtml:
BCECE Admission Mop-up Allotment Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB) has released the Mop-up Allotment Result for the Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination (BCECE -2026) For Admission in Engineering Stream, Medical Stream, Pharmacy Stream and Agriculture Stream. The online application process for BCECE Admission Online Form 2026 were accepted from 15 April 2026 to 13 May 2026 (Extended). The Examination was conducted On 30-31 May 2026. Candidates must download their BCECE Admission Mop-up Allotment Result 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 15 April 2026
  • Last Date : 13 May 2026 (Extended)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 13 May 2026
  • Online Editing-Application Form : 14 May 2026
  • New Exam Date (PCMB) : 30 May 2026
  • New Exam Date (Agri) : 31 May 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 22 May 2026
  • Result / Rank Card Available : 24 June 2026
  • Counselling/ Choice Filling : 19-25 July 2026
  • 1st Round Allotment Result : 29 July 2026
  • 2nd Round Allotment Result : 10 August 2026

Application Fee

  • PCM/ PCB/ CBA/ PCA/ MBA/ MCA Group
  • General, BC, EBC : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST, DQ : Rs. 500/-
  • PCMB Group
  • General, BC, EBC : Rs. 1100/-
  • SC, ST, DQ : Rs. 550/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
